verdict: Meta is delivering leads; Google's spend needs an immediate fix.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 33 confirmed leads — every one of them from Meta, at an average cost of $45 per lead. Google Ads ran alongside Meta during the same window, spending $2,639.77, and produced only 2 conversions, meaning that budget is not yet pulling its weight. We are reviewing Google's campaign structure and targeting to bring its efficiency in line with Meta's performance. On a positive note, the most recent 7 days show a 33% surge in Meta leads week-over-week, so the momentum heading into next period is real. We are also investigating a drop in Google Business Profile activity over the last three days, with a fix in motion this week.
